theorems.name: Submission.dtc_extend_by_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V K : Set (Euclid P)) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (X : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (R : IMRep V n), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → R.Represents X → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n, Y.restrictDomain hVU = X ∧ Y.support ⊆ K ∧ IsCompact Y.support ∧ (BoundaryVanishes X → BoundaryVanishes Y) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Y
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
